annotations.title: Evidence on a counterparty before trading (paid)

description: Before trading with an agent or service: what the records actually say about it, in one answer. Identity links with their strength (declared by the agent, observed by us, or corroborated by a second party), settled payment history with first and last payment, active months and long silences, counterparties with top-1 and top-3 share, Herfindahl and repeat ratio, each catalogued service with its price, how often it was paid at that price and whether delivery can be observed at all, what we cannot see, and whether there is enough history to conclude. Paid ($0.01). Settled payments, distinct counterparties and delivery evidence are SEPARATE figures and never a score: much measured agent-payment volume is self-dealing, wash or tests, and a payment does not show a service was delivered. Read `sufficiency` and `warnings` before any figure, and quote `guard` with them.

address.description: The agent or service address you are about to trade with.

name: counterparty_evidence

address.description: The address as we read it, normalised. Compare it with what you sent.

cannotSee.description: What the records behind this answer cannot show for this address. Quote it with the figures.

counterparties.description: unique, dealings, top1Share, top3Share, hhi (null below 10 dealings), repeatRatio, flags; status.

delivery.description: Per service: price, paid at that price, answered, deliveryObservable, says; status.

history.description: byRail, firstSettled, lastSettled, monthsActive, longestGapDays, gaps; status.

identity.description: links[] with kind, strength (declared | observed | corroborated), source, asOf; status.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

sufficiency.description: verdict (sufficient | insufficient-history) and missed[] naming each threshold.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.
